claims.claim: The YB1-X91L firmware does not describe the complete camera link. sources.title: [PATCH v4 14/15] media: atomisp: allow raw Bayer capture

claims.claim: AtomISP currently rejects all raw formats and silently substitutes YUV420. This prevents userspace camera processing stacks from obtaining unprocessed sensor frames. Enumerate only the raw format matching the sensor media-bus code and reconcile raw requests with the code selected by the sensor. Userspace opts in by selecting that raw V4L2 pixel format with VIDIOC_S_FMT. Raw formats expose the full sensor transport frame so ISP2401 can use its copy pipeline.
